Hero.title: Ticketing System
Hero.subtitle: LAIT (Leading Access to Integrated Ticketing) is an integrated ticket purchasing mechanism based on reward points, offering tourism benefits that are valid throughout Indonesia.

Features.title: LAIT Features
Features.subtitle: Discover how the LAIT Ticketing System delivers convenience and ease for its users
Features.benefit1: Unified interface across all ticketing systems
Features.benefit4: Reward points remain valid as long as the user uses the application
Features.travelPassDesc: Provides transport travel pass tickets available on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.
Features.rewardPointsDesc: Earn reward points with every transport ticket purchase and each ticket scan.
Features.tourismDesc: Offers various tourist attraction tickets across Indonesia, where reward points can be used as ticket discounts.
Features.paymentDesc: Supports various payment methods for ticket purchases, including QRIS, Virtual Account, Debit, and Credit Card.
